Usage: headroom resolve [<account>] [flags]

Print an account's name, dir and kind, for shell preflight.

Prints one line for shell preflight: the account's canonical name, its config dir and its
kind (primary or extra), separated by tabs. Bare, the pinned account; under automatic
placement there is no one account to print, so a name is required.

Arguments:
  <account>              The account to resolve; the pinned one when absent (optional).

Flags:
      --vendor=VENDOR    The vendor whose account this acts on (default: claude; one of: claude,
                         codex).

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help             Show context-sensitive help.
      --version          Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and
                         exit.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded
